Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"data/size","code":"buf.data = (UA_Byte*)data; buf.length = size;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a JSON byte string and passed into the decoder.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":25,"var":"out","code":"UA_decodeJson(&buf, &out, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_VARIANT]);","note":"The fuzzer decodes the input as a Variant, so nested JSON can instantiate heap-backed built-in types.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buf"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2719,"var":"dst->value","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_VALUE, &dst->value, (decodeJsonSignature) Variant_decodeJson, false, NULL}","note":"Variant decoding dispatches the Body field into a nested decoder, allowing attacker-controlled object graphs to be materialized.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"variant body"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2742,"var":"dst->type","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_BODY, dst, (decodeJsonSignature) Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject, false, NULL}","note":"The Variant decoder can unwrap ExtensionObjects and recursively decode the embedded body as another concrete type.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"type dispatch"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"LocalizedText_decodeJson","line":2226,"var":"dst->locale / dst->text","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_LOCALE, &dst->locale, (decodeJsonSignature) String_decodeJson, false, NULL}, {UA_JSONKEY_TEXT, &dst->text, (decodeJsonSignature) String_decodeJson, false, NULL}","note":"The crafted Variant body is decoded as a LocalizedText, allocating separate heap strings for locale and text.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"nested type selection"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->locale / p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"When the decoded Variant is later deleted, both string members are freed through the LocalizedText clear routine.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"deleteMembers"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":null,"var":"p->data","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"Each string clear releases the heap buffer and nulls the pointer, so any alias to the same buffer becomes dangling after cleanup.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"freed string buffer"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"The generic clear dispatcher is the sink that walks the decoded object graph and invokes the nested frees.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"control","via":"dispatcher"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"Variant_clear","line":415,"var":"p->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(p->data, p->arrayLength, p->type);","note":"If the Variant body contains aliased members or repeated ownership, the array delete path can free the same heap region more than once or leave a dangling reference behind.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"ownership mismatch"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":null,"var":"p->data","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"A second access to the same string storage during cleanup is the memory-safety sink, matching the reported heap-use-after-free read.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"dangling string alias"}]}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc2.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
